title: Grateful Dead Live at Golden Hall, Community Concourse on 1982-02-20

ai_review.summary: Pristine audience recording captures a high‑energy Golden Hall show with a monster Let It Grow and a flawless Franklin’s→Samson transition.
ai_review.review: The tape delivers surprisingly clear, almost studio‑like sound for an audience source, letting listeners feel the 1982 vibe of the small venue. Musically the concert is a standout – an 18‑minute Let It Grow, one of the best “China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider” jams, and the rare Franklin’s Tower opening that slides seamlessly into Samson make this night unforgettable.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers rate the show 4‑5 stars and praise both performance (high energy, superb jams) and sound quality (crisp/pristine). Only one lower‑rated comment notes sketchy audio, so overall rating is strongly positive.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Many note the recording as crisp and pristine; a few mention occasional sketchiness or mic issues (e.g., Sony ECM‑220T). Overall the tape captures the venue ambience while remaining clear enough for detailed listening.

standout_songs: China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider
show_quality.setlist_flow: The set flows naturally, with a rare Franklin’s opening that transitions flawlessly into Samson, followed by high‑energy blues jams and a soaring second set.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia "tears up" Let It Grow with soaring lead work; his tone is praised throughout.
band_member_comments.Bob: Bob adds a vocal cue (“Pay Attention!”) during Samson, contributing to the show’s excitement.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent's solo jam into the drums is highlighted as a standout keyboard moment.
